constraints: Do not commit or push without explicit permission.
Never read or expose .env contents, private keys, seed phrases, wallet secrets, or API credentials.
Do not copy private cross-repo information into this public repo.
Trust the codebase over summaries when they conflict.
Use package managers for dependency changes instead of hand-editing manifests.
Keep whitespace clean and leave one empty line at end of file.
working_preferences: Keep moving through straightforward requested tasks without unnecessary pauses.
Be extensive when creating repo-local context exports.
Differentiate exact snapshots, direct quotes, and reconstructed history.
Use task tracking for multi-step work.
Do not remove comments unless the associated code is being removed.
next_agent_guidance: Start with MASTER_INDEX_AND_MANIFEST, NEXT_AGENT_START_HERE, and the stable CANONICAL_PROJECT_STATE.json.
Use DECISION_LEDGER and KNOWN_RISKS_AND_GOTCHAS before making architectural assumptions.
Use FILE_PRIORITY_AND_OWNERSHIP_GUIDE and VALIDATION_MATRIX before editing product code.
If resuming product work, the visible open priorities are SweetAlerts for Skills Planets and Add Multi-Chain Support.

high: narrative summaries from accessible session history
mixed: quote-heavy reconstructions where direct quotes and summary-based reconstruction are combined
reconstructed: prior-session history recovered from preserved summaries
